notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Demo Update Complete! (Version 0.3.1)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Isekai Adventurer Guild.

Version 0.3.1 update has been completed. 

Here are the changes:
[hr][/hr]🔹 Main Changes[olist]
Back Attack feature has been added.

[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45558211/db193fc377333551291301635f8e7a83ce7e2f4b.gif"]

Back Attacks can only be performed with melee skills, and final damage is increased by 10%.

Critical Hit text has been added when landing a critical attack.

[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45558211/76ec73b6ff1ab46347a5b008d13b0ea9ec84b4d1.gif"]

Rank-up effects are now displayed on the adventure result screen.
[/olist][hr][/hr]
We’ll continue to do our best to make your guild life even more enjoyable. Thank you!

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Demo Update Complete! (Version 0.3.0)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Isekai Adventurer Guild.

Version 0.3.0 update has been completed. 

Here are the changes:
[hr][/hr]🔹 Main Changes[olist]
Random boxes now appear in dungeons.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/a424d402ba46434c87cf797891b488e775c56864.gif"]

These boxes may contain recovery, item drops, traps, or other random effects.

Added 10 new types of Blessing Cards.

Movement range and attack range colors are now displayed differently.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/0cea4a75df9ff804025ad22e1f911a4e661e43af.png"]

Skill ranges now clearly distinguish allies and enemies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/2a9a904645562ea6355ca4435ba7f19be6c9b9ef.png"]

Additional indicators appear on tiles where skills can be used.

Portals now spawn in dungeons.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/ed1d788a050a3697076eebc1d6df68da846d7b9b.gif"]

Stepping on a portal will teleport the character to another portal’s location.
Portals disappear after being used.

Monsters in the "Suspicious Forest" now deal more damage but have lower HP.

EXP distribution adjusted:
Before: Last hitter 100%, other party members 40%
Now: Last hitter 100%, other party members 50% (Support classes 80%)

Guild Master’s backstory has been added to the early tutorial.

Cancel Action hotkey now includes ESC.
Option hotkey during adventure changed from ESC → F1.

End Turn can now be used as a battle start hotkey.

Berserk Mode changed to Dungeon’s Curse.
HP can no longer be recovered by Rest, and MP recovery is reduced.

Blessing Card skill names (1, 2, 3) now match each adventurer correctly.

Clicking objects while in wait state now shows a description popup.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/031b897b5d4af95735515a9c774a6c50955e45a6.png"]

Blessing Cards no longer appear with mismatched attack types.
(Ex: Physical adventurers will not receive Magic Attack blessing.)

Swap function added during adventurer placement.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/d8419547085c4e79aa568d9715d009b536ea2a5b.gif"]

Monster attack ranges now also show movement distance.

Buff/Debuff mini-icons added, displaying remaining turns and simple info.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/52960ff7556b737f44fac446a2984923aae5eca0.png"]

Top UI now displays HP/MP in a slimmer format.
[/olist][hr][/hr]🔹 Other Changes[olist]
Resolution options added to game settings.

Fixed skip button hotkey triggering in name input screen.

MP gauge now appears below mini HP gauge above characters.

Highlight added in character selection tutorial.

Adjusted monster placement in certain dungeons.

Revised screen movement tutorial text.
[/olist][hr][/hr]
Thanks to your support, we’ve reached over 10,000 wishlists!

We’ll continue to do our best to make your guild life even more enjoyable. Thank you!

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Demo Update Complete! (Version 0.2.6)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Isekai Adventurer Guild.

Version 0.2.6 update has been completed. Here are the changes:
[hr][/hr]🔹 Main Changes[olist]
Rest can now be used in Berserk Mode, but its effectiveness is significantly reduced while the mode is active.

The movement algorithm has been adjusted to avoid traps more effectively.

Some full-area buff skills have been changed to targetable-area skills.
[/olist][hr][/hr]


We’ll continue working hard to bring you even better adventures. Thank you!

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Demo Update Complete! (Version 0.2.5)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Isekai Adventurer Guild.

Version 0.2.5 update has been completed.
Here are the changes:
[hr][/hr]🔹 Main Changes[olist]
You can now select adventurers for Normal Quests.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/111e631f8b42fd85243c57e09fdbdde4e2cbcd72.png"]

Start a quest with 1 or 3 adventurers.

If only 1 is selected, the others will be assigned randomly.

Adventurer dot graphics have been updated.

A Vigor system has been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/4bc36ca63b1f4b093b7e0e543001e3081d616604.png"]

Vigor has 5 levels. Higher levels grant buffs.

Adventurers with 0 Vigor cannot go on quests.

Vigor decreases by 1 when participating in quests.

Randomly assigned adventurers do not lose Vigor.

Adventurers who don’t join quests recover 1 Vigor.

Eating food at the Tavern restores 1 Vigor for all.

Resting is now disabled in Berserk Mode.

Potions now appear in dungeons.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/b7f997be99f8f41052a61c79345b77983b3ee1ef.gif"]

Potions spawn randomly and restore HP or Mana by percentage.

Moving to collect a potion disables movement cancel for that turn.

Traps have been added to dungeons.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/a98a5415d23e4623414fc89b88eedf5916771d9e.gif"]

Triggered by movement or knockback onto the tile.

Traps ignore defense and deal fixed damage of 10% Max HP.

Traps affect both monsters and adventurers.

The Guild Master now supports quests.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/de69aefa4bf4928cab811df532785aef89e4538a.png"]

Guild Master is added as a basic adventurer.

Some early tutorial dialogues have been updated.

Collision damage has been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/664e5f32b4549678c5e350ad5b8d9771f6c4cde0.gif"]

Knockback collisions deal damage to both adventurers and monsters.

Collision damage is 50% of fall damage.

Dungeon monster distribution has been adjusted.

Guild Fund rewards from quests have been increased.

This change applies only to the demo version.

A new feature allows you to move the screen by hovering the mouse near the edge.
[/olist][hr][/hr]


We’ll continue working hard to bring you even better adventures. Thank you!

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Demo Update Complete! (Version 0.2.2)
notes.notes:
Hello,
This is Isekai Adventurer Guild.

The version 0.2.2 update is now live!
Here are the changes included in this update:


[hr][/hr]🔹 Main Changes[olist]
Rest efficiency has been increased from 8% to 10%.

Mana recovered upon level-up has been increased from 15% to 20%.

Mana costs for some skills have been slightly reduced.

A feature has been added that allows skills to be immediately canceled by pressing the skill button again while in standby mode.

Guild funds are now displayed in the upper right corner of the guild main screen.

The background music in the "Suspicious Forest" has been changed.
[/olist][hr][/hr]
We will continue doing our best to make your adventures even more enjoyable. Thank you!

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Join the Steam Next Fest! (Update 0.2.1)
notes.notes:
Hello! This is Isekai Adventurer Guild.
We’ve joined Steam Next Fest!
Take on thrilling quests with a wide variety of adventurers during the event!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/c140db1910178171a313a3de1fceeb5623f49d45.png"]

The starting adventurers are now randomly selected when you begin your journey!

You can reroll the starting lineup by resetting your data in the settings.
Try out different combinations and tackle new missions!


Other Changes[olist]
Base stats of melee characters have been slightly increased.

Blessings that increase defense and rest efficiency have been slightly buffed.

Default camera lock is now set to OFF. (You can toggle this in the top-right of the battle screen.)

HP/MP bars now appear beneath adventurer portraits in the Blessing UI.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Demo Update Complete! (Version 0.2.0)
notes.notes:
Hello, Adventurers!
Welcome to the world of Isekai Adventurer Guild!
Version 0.2.0 update is now live.
Check out what’s new below!

Next Fest Demo Changes
These updates apply to the demo version only.

1. The quest limit has been increased from 5 to 7.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/69baa0d1ebb9441e74fa4ff150d0bd2e163c07d7.png
2. Open Adventure is now available!
 - A randomized combat zone each time you explore.
 - You can bring 1 to 3 adventurers.
 - Continue adventuring until you choose to stop!
 - Only adventurers of Rank B or higher may join.
 - Free Exploration does not consume quest slots.

3. The list of starting adventurers has been updated.

4. Quest rewards have been boosted to support faster growth.
 - The full version will feature different reward values.

5. Hitting the quest limit no longer forces a data reset.
 - While you can't do more quests, Free Exploration remains available.

Major Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/a9373338ae44adc688772fafea4666a51909b200.png
1. New Adventurer "Izuna Hazuki" has joined the Guild!
 - Meet this katana-wielding warrior from Japan.
 - Discover her summoning story through the Memory Orb.
 - Reset demo data in Settings to meet her!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/a02b3b89738dddd35988924663e648061cdd6492.png
2. Rank Effect Selection System has been added.
 - Customize rank bonuses to suit your adventurer’s build.

3. Guild Level Buff is now available.
 - All guild adventurers gain passive stat boosts as the Guild levels up.
 - No extra cost — higher levels expand its power!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/806b870749d45521325f4c3da88e9cc1f33cc4dc.png
4. Tavern Level System added.
 - Upgrade the Tavern using guild funds.
 - Higher levels increase food buff effectiveness.

5. Blessings from Growth and Dungeon Shrines have been expanded.
 - Extremely overpowered blessings have been rebalanced.

Other Changes
1. Clicking a monster during ally turn shows its current HP.

2. Animation and sound effects added to result and enhancement UIs.

3. Hotkeys are now displayed in the in-battle pause menu.

4. Portraits added to the Blessing Selection UI.

5. Rank changes are now shown on the result screen.

6. Shortcut keys are now active in the dialogue window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/1a347bb2d27ec5ed37b839c9abbb7ef4fb2e5424.png
7. Tile visuals for skill range indicators have been updated.

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Version 0.1.1 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Hello! This is Isekai Adventurer Guild.
Version 0.1.1 has been updated.
Here are the changes:

[Main Changes]
1. The same Blessing effect of the same rank will no longer appear multiple times.

2. Skill information is now displayed at the top while waiting to use a skill.

3. If an adventurer has completed all actions (attack and move), focus will automatically shift to the next character.

4. When all adventurers have completed their actions, the turn will automatically end.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/e3ac25c3aefccd45ef0d9338c34fe8576d33d43a.png
5. The starting tile positions have been changed in all areas.

6. Shortcut keys (Y/N) are now assigned to pop-up UIs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/856ead9c76e30626ba637d9b740f892cc7a88523.png
7. You can now view the quest target in the request board.

8. Quest information can now be viewed during battle.

9. You can now view rank info in adventurer details during battle.

10. Next/Previous buttons have been added to the adventurer information screen.

11. Raylin’s Skill 1 “Magic Bolt” has been changed to “Fire Bolt.”

12. Attribute display during skill use has been adjusted.

13. Fixed an issue where Karen’s attack direction was occasionally incorrect.

14. Fixed a bug where a dead adventurer could still use rest.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Isekai Adventurer Guild] Version 0.1.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Hello! This is Isekai Adventurer Guild.

Version 0.1.0 update is now live!

Here are the details of the changes:

Demo Version Updates

1. The quest limit in the demo has been increased from 4 to 5.

2. One additional B-rank difficulty quest has been added.

3. The drop rate for enhancement materials has been increased by 30%.

4. Gold rewards from quests have been increased.

※ These changes apply only to the demo version and may differ in the full release.

Major Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/78309eae34aaf67aa923e95e71f6ced86a5c2863.png
1. The battle preparation UI has been revamped.

2. A "Cancel Move" feature has been added.

If you move during your turn, you can revert to your original position.

However, this cannot be used after attacking or resting.

3. Hotkeys have been changed:

Character Selection → 1, 2, 3

Start Battle → 4

Skills → Q, W, E

Move, Cancel Move, Rest → A, S, D

Skill Details → SPACE

Camera Move → Drag with Middle Mouse Button

Cancel Input → Right Click

4. Skill range previews have been added.

5. Movement range will now automatically display when selecting a character.

6. Skill information UI animations and displays have been improved.

Toggle with the SPACE key.

7. A "Character View" feature has been added.

You can toggle it on/off from the top right.

When active, the camera will no longer automatically follow the character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558211/d2729239a3e757a59fe74374ac26f08d704b5b68.png
8. When selecting enemy units, their movement and attack information will now be displayed.

9. Sound effects have been added to certain actions.

10. A warning popup will now appear if you try to end your turn without using all attack actions.

11. Profile icons will now change more clearly when an action is completed.

12. A new profile icon will be shown when a character becomes incapacitated.

13. Hovering over a character's profile image will now display their attribute affinities.

14. When recruiting adventurers, your current guild funds will be displayed.

15. Karen’s Skill 1 has been changed to "Luck Manipulation".

Luck Manipulation: Attacks an enemy while granting a critical hit chance buff to allies.

Thank you!

notes.title: Upcoming Demo Content Changes
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the demo!

We're currently working on improvements to the combat UI/UX based on the valuable feedback we've received.
Following these updates, we plan to introduce several changes to the demo version.

🔹 1. Changes to Starting Adventurers
The current starting lineup is fixed: Bruce, Aiden, Karen, and Raelin (via summoning).

Going forward, 1 or 2 of these characters will be rotated periodically with other adventurers.

The rotation schedule will be announced at a later date.

🔹 2. Upcoming Free Adventure Mode
We'll be opening a limited-time "Free Adventure Mode" where players can freely repeat adventures and farm enhancement materials.

Don’t miss this exclusive opportunity to experience the mode before the full release!

We hope you continue to enjoy the demo until the full version launches.
Thank you again!

For the latest updates, be sure to check out our Discord first!
